Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Michael Porter Jr.?

Michael Porter Jr. is 28 years old.

Where was Michael Porter Jr. born?

Michael Porter Jr. was born in Indianapolis, Indiana.

When was Michael Porter Jr. born?

Michael Porter Jr. was born on June 29, 1998.

How tall is Michael Porter Jr.?

Michael Porter Jr. is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much does Michael Porter Jr. weigh?

Michael Porter Jr. weighs 218 lbs (98 kg).

Is Michael Porter Jr. in the Hall of Fame?

Michael Porter Jr. is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Michael Porter Jr. drafted?

Michael Porter Jr. was drafted by Denver Nuggets, 1st round (14th pick, 14th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Michael Porter Jr. play?

Small Forward.

What is Michael Porter Jr.'s net worth?

Michael Porter Jr. has made at least $153,586,695 playing professional basketball.

How much does Michael Porter Jr. make?

Michael Porter Jr. made $38,333,050 in 2026.

How many rings does Michael Porter Jr. have?

Michael Porter Jr. has won one championship.

What is Michael Porter Jr.'s Instagram account?

Michael Porter Jr. is on Instagram at mpj.

What schools did Michael Porter Jr. attend?

Michael Porter Jr. attended Nathan Hale in Seattle, Washington and Missouri.

What are Michael Porter Jr.'s nicknames?

MPJ, Showtime, Never Swing the Rock are nicknames for Michael Porter Jr..

Is Michael Porter Jr. injured?

Michael Porter Jr. is listed as Out For Season (Hamstring) - Porter (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season, according to Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com.
